description: Gold resource stone props for the Tiny Swords asset pack. Each variant is a static 128x128 sprite with a separate 6-frame highlight animation sheet from Gold Stones.aseprite.

props.order: After ground tiles, cliff bases, and stair ramps; before top overlays (clouds, etc.).
props.note: Props at the same tile row are drawn in map order; props further south (higher y) draw on top of props further north.

anchor.note: Bottom-centre of the sprite meets the ground tile.

footprint.note: Collision/placement occupies one 64x64 tile; sprite artwork extends above the cell.

usage.summary: Selection/highlight ring for Gold Stone 1. Loop at 10 fps when the stone is targeted.
usage.note: Draw above the base stone sprite on the props layer. Gameplay pickup semantics deferred to backlog.

usage.summary: Gold resource stone variant 1. Static 128x128 prop.
usage.note: Anchor bottom-centre on walkable land. Pair with highlightAnimation for editor selection feedback.

onLandOnly.rule: Place only on land cells (elevation >= 0). Never on water, cliff-face cells, cliff-base cells, or stair/ramp cells.
onLandOnly.appliesTo: Walkable grass at any elevation tier.
onLandOnly.doNotApply: Water (elevation -1), cells below south-facing cliffs, ramp landing/top cells.

preferInteriorGrass.rule: Prefer fully-surrounded centre grass (autotile piece 5, mask 1111) for consistent scatter with other props.
